objective: Verify whether the catalogue stocks the Carhartt 'Stretch Rugged 3EY-11K Work Trousers' base product, then check whether the claimed extra catalogue properties (color family Blue, size XS, fit women) hold for that record, answering <YES> or <NO> with the checked SKU.

params.base_sku: lookup product_sku from product_variants WHERE brand normalized (LOWER/TRIM) matches 'Carhartt' AND series/model/product_name matches a short normalized token of the 'Stretch Rugged 3EY-11K Work Trousers' line (LIKE on a minimal token); bind base = first matching row
params.extra_claim_holds: test whether the matched base SKU also carries color_family=Blue AND size=XS AND fit=women, via product_variant_properties (property_key/property_value_text) and/or product_variants.properties; true only if every claimed extra property is present on the checked SKU

constraints.rule: Check the actual catalogue item, cite the exact product record

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: Checked catalogue record {record_path}: {YES_or_NO} — Carhartt Stretch Rugged 3EY-11K Work Trousers base SKU {sku}; claimed extras (color family Blue, size XS, fit women) {present_or_absent}.
